$comment: Manifest for a VFX sub-program. The viewer tool reads these; Blender scripts write them. Adding a new effect = add a new directory with one of these.
name: Fire Shield - Idle
description: Persistent fire shield aura: a ring of rising flame tongues around the unit, a hot core, bright beads tracing the barrier's edge, and embers drifting upward. Loops seamlessly.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: resolution is the GAMEPLAY cell. Authoring is 512px and pack_sheets downsamples to 128, because flame detail is sub-pixel at 128 and averages to a flat block.

anchor.$comment: Normalized pivot within one frame. 0.5,0.5 = centre. The shield is anchored on the unit it protects.

layers.note: Small hot pool behind the flames. Deliberately small (0.26 units) and dim (strength 0.6) - at larger sizes it dominated and read as a pale egg.

14 upright cards on a ring of radius 0.42. Card height scales with ring depth so the far side is tall and the near side short - that vertical stagger is what reads as a dome rather than a band. Noise mapping scrolls upward for the rise.
20 beads tracing the barrier edge, following the same depth lift. This is what makes it read as a BARRIER rather than a fire cloud.
10 embers rising with drag and fade-out.

knownIssues: Rim beads read slightly as a chain of separate balls rather than a continuous edge. A continuous rim mesh would be cleaner but costs a separate alpha material.
Ring silhouette is a dome only because of the depth-lift stagger; it is not true 3D geometry, so rotating the unit would not rotate the shield.
